name: attic/arm32
description: The 32-bit ARM back end, assembler and disassembler.
residual: configs/env.yml knows Linux64 and Win64 only: this target is not built here, so the code is unverified by construction. It is what a LinARM-32 tarball (idea 2d) would need, and idea 2d is deferred because 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS runs our linux-arm64 tarball today.
Not to be confused with FoxA64*, which is ours and is in std/compiler.
